name: Sichuan Kelun-Biotech Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Kelun-Biotech Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures and commercialises new drugs in oncology, immunology, metabolism and other areas, in China and internationally. Its pipeline includes Sac-TMT, a novel TROP2 antibody-drug conjugate positioned as monotherapy and in combination therapies.
